item.title: The 8 Best Castlevania Games Of All Time, Ranked
item.description: Castlevania is one of the most beloved franchises in video game history, despite a period of 13 years when we didn’t see a new installment until the launch of Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse earlier this year.

item.title: 10 Essential GBA Games Still Disappointingly Missing From Nintendo Switch Online
item.description: When the original Game Boy came out, games like the ones people enjoyed on their NES were finally playable on the go, and players loved Nintendo for it. The green and black color palette was a bit of a bummer, but finally was rectified with the Game Boy Color. Even so, most of the games were still pretty basic. The next step was to make a handheld unit that could replicate the superior experience offered on the Super Nintendo, and the Game Boy Advance did precisely that.

item.title: 10 Devastating Game Cancellations That Are Still Disappointing Years Later
item.description: Sometimes, it’s fun to think about the great games that might have been — until they were canceled without ever getting the chance to make their mark. Most of the time, we just shrug our shoulders and move on, because that’s life. But sometimes, we mourn the wasted potential.

item.title: GTA 6's Biggest Competition Officially Arrives on PC in 2027
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to dominate 2026 with its long-awaited release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, another game — one heavily inspired by GTA, Marvel's Spider-Man , and Genshin Impact — will give Rockstar Games a run for its money: Ananta .

item.title: Ryan Gosling is Officially Reviving The Flintstones for New Project
item.description: Ryan Gosling has been incredibly booked and busy of late. He starred in the lead role in the sci-fi smash hit Project Hail Mary earlier this year. In 2027, he'll travel to the galaxy far, far away in St ar Wars: Starfighter . Then in 2028 he'll make his long-awaited MCU debut as Ghost Rider , re-teaming with Starfighter director Shawn Levy. If all that wasn't enough, Gosling has lined up one more unexpected project: The Flintstones .

item.title: Every GTA Game, Ranked by Metacritic Score
item.description: With plenty of installments boasting Metacritic scores in the high 90s, GTA 6 has an exceptionally high bar to meet. That said, the series has had occasional growing pains over the years, even if true stinkers are a rarity among Rockstar Games’ back catalog. These are the top 10 GTA games of all time, ranked according to their Metacritic scores.

item.title: All Happy Mask Shop buyer locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's Happy Mask Shop quest sends you around Hyrule peddling masks to specific customers. That sounds like a cushy gig, except you have very little guidance about who your customers are, and you occasionally even have to pay back the cost of the mask, too. However, if you want a big chunk of cash and a chance to see and hear everything in Ocarina of Time , it's worth the hassle.

item.title: Where to get Epona in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Epona is your trusty steed in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. Hyrule Field is a large zone, and running across it can take a long time. So, speed up the process a bit by calling Epona to your side. However, you'll need to wait a bit before you can ride her.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and Peacock (November 6 - 8)
item.description: Happy weekend! It’s a good one for new movie releases, from genre offerings to independent films that could be award contenders in the coming months. Godzilla Minus Zero is finally out, with our review calling it the best Godzilla movie of all time, an endorsement that should send any Polygon readers straight to their nearest movie theater. In independent cinema, there’s Club Kid , which has inspired award buzz and is out on limited release. Ramayana: Part 1, the latest Indian cinematic epic, is also currently in theaters and earning strong reviews (just make sure to watch the full Hindi version, not the shortened English dub).

item.title: All Big Poe locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Big Poes are large ghosts that are hiding around Hyrule Field in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. Like regular Poes, you can store Big Poes in bottles, and sell them to the Poe Collector in Hyrule Castle Town. However, Big Poes are worth a whopping 30 rupees, so if you collect them all, you'll get a good chunk of change.
